description: Get captured raw JSON data (GraphQL/XHR) for the current tab, bypassing DOM virtualization

clear.description: Clear the buffer after reading (default: true)

output_file.description: Filename to write the payload under ~/.poltertab/downloads/, returning only a summary (row count, field names, fill rates, two sample records). .jsonl and .csv are written in those formats when the payload carries records, anything else as JSON. A path is reduced to its basename — output cannot be written elsewhere.

session.description: Named session (tab) to run against; it becomes the current tab. browser_navigate with a new name opens it its own tab, so a loop can keep one tab instead of opening hundreds. Other tools error on a name that does not exist yet.

tabId.description: Act on this tab (an id from browser_tab_list) without making it current. Omit to use this agent's current tab: the last one navigated, opened or switched to. A tabId Chrome does not have returns tab_not_found.

name: browser_get_network_state
